title: Check Root Filesystem
description: Check only the root filesystem disk usage and alert above a threshold.
script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

THRESHOLD="${THRESHOLD:-80}"

USAGE=$(df -P / | awk 'NR==2 {gsub("%","",$5); print $5}')

echo "Root filesystem usage: ${USAGE}%"

if (( USAGE >= THRESHOLD )); then
    echo "WARNING: / is above ${THRESHOLD}%"
    exit 1
fi

echo "OK: / is below the threshold."
